cells.gaps: No regulation under law n°001-2021/AN is on record. No named sanction or published count of decisions is on record; the CIL made no public report in 2024. The data protection bill voted in August 2026 has no promulgation stated.
cells.note: Law n°001-2021/AN is stated in force and the August 2026 data protection bill is only voted, so it is a flag and not a repeal. ARCOD, which absorbs the CIL, has its president and first college named (BFA-037, 19 November 2026), so the authority stays constituted; application is still activity only, so stage 4 is not reached.
